description: The Dark Energy Camera (DECam) medium-band filter set (M411, M438, M464, M490, M517) on the Blanco 4m telescope, designed for intermediate-band mapping of Lyman-alpha emitters and Lyman break galaxies.
facility_description: The Víctor M. Blanco 4-meter Telescope is an optical reflecting telescope at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) in Chile, operated by NSF NOIRLab.
